title: Mined entities link to the Reference they came from
description: Finding: only 13 mentions go from a Reference to a concept, against 408 from Items, though Ryan expects mining from References. `publish_run.py` has `is_reference_mention`, and `monitor_import.py` writes some. First find out why accepted References get so few: is extraction only over published Items and corpus records, or are the links lost? Then make every accepted Reference get `mentions` links, with a backfill. Done when: share of accepted References with at least one mention is reported per run, and on Machines on Machines most have one. Ordinary get-or-create (PPY-891a3f).
